paper_metadata.title: Controlling the grain boundary morphology and secondary γ′ precipitate size distribution in Ni-base superalloys

evidence.quote: The size, morphology and fraction of each of the γ′ precipitate populations in polycrystalline γ- γ′ nickel-base superalloys are highly sensitive to th e cooling rate from the solution temperature.

For many polycrystalline Ni-base superalloys, understanding and controlling the cooling processes from above the solvus temperature plays an important role in modifying and altering the microstructure
